# Nexyyra Events

> Luxury event management company headquartered in Telhara, Maharashtra, India — weddings, corporate events, destination celebrations, and celebrity experiences across Pune and all of India since 2012. Founded by Yash Bajaj in Amravati in 2012; Aaditya Padiya and Amey Korde joined as co-founders in 2026.

Legal name: Nexyyra Events and Promotions Private Limited. CIN: U70200ME2026PTC476014. Nexyyra Events is a premium event planning and production company serving clients across India, specializing in end-to-end luxury experiences — from intimate weddings to large-scale corporate galas and destination celebrations. Services include luxury wedding planning, destination weddings, corporate events and brand activations, celebrity and VIP event management, concert and exhibition management, fashion shows, cultural events, venue curation, and event production. Tagline: The Next Era of Celebrations.

Contact: Phone/WhatsApp +91 9730594753 (https://wa.me/919730594753), email Info.Events@nexyyra.com. Registered office: Aaditya Seva Sadan, Hiwarkhed - Telhara Rd, near petrol pump, Gajanan Nagar, Telhara, Maharashtra 444108. Delivery and coordination office: Pune, Maharashtra, India. Leadership: Yash Bajaj (Founder & Managing Director, since 2012), Aaditya Padiya (Co-Founder & CTO, since 2026), Amey Korde (Co-Founder & CMO, since 2026), Shilpa Sharma (Finance & Accounts Manager), Radhika Bajaj (Data & Administration Manager), Bharti Jadhav (Head, Decoration Department).
